profile.description: izad is a social women headed organization
profile.mission: Our Mission statement is “Transform development of people through participatory practice on sustained basis” we focus on women and children.
profile.vision: The Vision of IZAD is to develop itself as a unique and point of excellence by utilizing need based innovative methods to establish a just society where the people with particular thrust to the disadvantaged class will lead an honorable life.
